quotes.text: Self service without structure doesn't just blow up your budget, it undermines the very reason BI exists, consistent trusted insight.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: States why ungoverned self-service BI hurts both cost and trust in the numbers.

quotes.text: The sprawl itself becomes the driver of the bill, not any one big purchase decision.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Pinpoints workspace sprawl, not a single licensing choice, as the real cost driver.

quotes.text: The waste only comes when nobody draws boundaries with proper guardrails. Decentralization actually cuts costs because you stop paying for cloned storage and redundant licenses.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Challenges the assumption that decentralized BI is automatically more expensive.

quotes.text: Training often reduces costs more than enforcement because people stop creating problems in the first place.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Makes the case for mentoring over policing in a BI Center of Excellence.

quotes.text: Bottom line PPUs for pilots capacities for scale. Confuse the two and you'll end up paying more than you expect while adoption raises ahead of control.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A simple rule of thumb for choosing between per-user and capacity licensing.

takeaways: Fabric and Power BI costs usually explode because uncontrolled self-service creates duplicate workspaces, cloned semantic models and extra refreshes, not because of one wrong purchase.
Fabric domains, endorsed semantic models in the OneLake catalog and build permissions let teams keep self-service freedom while reusing one certified model instead of cloning it.
A BI Center of Excellence should plan licensing early, using Premium Per User for pilots and premium capacity for scale, and back it with workspace policies, training and a community of practice.
hook: When your BI bill starts rivaling your ERP and nobody can explain why, the cause is usually self-service sprawl rather than a single bad licensing decision. This episode shows BI leaders and Fabric admins how domains, certified semantic models and a Center of Excellence keep self-service fast while making licensing costs predictable.
